title: Nested-open compatibility of the constructed comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i:W\hookrightarrow U$ an inclusion of arbitrary opens. Suppose the derived module categories on $X,U,W$ exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Supply adjunctions $a_U:D(L_U)\dashv Rj_{U*}$ and $a_W:D(L_W)\dashv Rj_{W*}$ for the functors of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For the constructed comparisons $c_U,c_W$ of [def-pc-open-image-complex-comparison-iso], the fixed underived complex restriction $\rho_{U,W}$ of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data] satisfies $c_W\circ Q(\rho_{U,W})=\rho^{D}_{U,W}(Q(I))\circ c_U$, where $\rho^D$ is schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction for $a_U,a_W$.

source.place: Tag 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), first proof paragraph and displayed restriction/direct-image sequence; Tag 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open)

proof.text: For the canonical derived adjunctions, localize the mate formula defining schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction. Apply the derived-unit and derived-counit factorization identities to its transpose. K-injectivity of the restrictions, proved in the construction node, identifies the direct-image computation components. The factorization equations of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso identify the localized nested restriction isomorphism with schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso. The localized mate is therefore exactly the displayed derived mate.

Normalize to the supplied adjunctions using beta_A=rightAdjointUniq. The identities eta_supplied=eta_canonical beta_A and L_A(beta_A) epsilon_supplied=epsilon_canonical, substituted in the mate formula, yield beta_U rho_supplied=rho_canonical beta_W by naturality of beta_W. Postcomposing the canonical computation comparisons with beta_U and beta_W gives the assertion. The proof is valid for equal or empty opens; it needs no cover or termwise injectivity.

theorem schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison_restriction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {W U : X.Opens} (i : W ⟶ U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (adjU : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
    (adjW : (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X i I) ≫
        (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X W I adjW).hom =
      (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X U I adjU).hom ≫
        schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X i adjU adjW (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
